close_reason: Ran cargo fmt --all to clean the tree. Also fixed 4 clippy::empty_line_after_doc_comments regressions caused by my .21 #[must_use] removal (left blank lines between doc and fn signature). cargo fmt --check is now clean exit 0; clippy --workspace -D warnings passes.
description:
rustfmt 1.8.0-stable (current stable as of 2026-03-02) reports 99 diffs across 14 files in the workspace. Per AGENTS.md pre-push checklist, `cargo fmt --all` is mandatory before committing.

Affected files (with diff counts):
  pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs: 7
  pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs: 25
  pkix-lint/src/lib.rs: 9
  pkix-lint/src/report.rs: 2
  pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs: 9
  pkix-path/src/lib.rs: 15
  pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_6_4_7.rs: 1
  pkix-path-builder/tests/integration.rs: 2
  pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs: 8
  pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs: 4
  pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs: 4
  pkix-revocation/tests/crl_checker_tests.rs: 4
  pkix-revocation/tests/ocsp_checker_tests.rs: 9
  (total: 99)

Reproduction:
  cargo fmt --all -- --check    # exits non-zero, prints all diffs

The diffs are mostly pure-syntax (`const X: T = | ObjectIdentifier::new_unwrap(...)` collapsed onto one line, etc.) — they were likely fmt-clean against an older rustfmt and a more recent rustfmt has tightened heuristics. Two response options:

A. Run `cargo fmt --all` and commit the changes. Lowest-friction — re-aligns the tree with the current stable rustfmt.

B. Pin rustfmt via a `rust-toolchain.toml` so the project's intended formatting is reproducible across developer machines.

Pass-1 attribution: P4 commit 01908663 includes 'clippy bulk fixes' and was the most recent commit; it should have left the tree fmt-clean. It did not.

Severity: P2 because the project's own AGENTS.md mandates fmt --check passing pre-push, so this is a violation of project policy. Not P1 because no semantic correctness is affected.
title: P2: cargo fmt --check fails on 99 ranges across 14 files; CI policy is broken
